profile.headline: Engineering Manager | Distributed Systems | SaaS Platforms | Cloud & Microservices | Scaling High-Performance Engineering Teams
profile.summary:
I’m an Engineering Leader with 15+ years of experience building scalable SaaS platforms and leading high-performing development teams. I specialize in distributed systems, backend architecture, and platform engineering that enable teams to deliver reliable, high-impact products at scale.

Currently Engineering Manager at Mythical Games where I lead teams developing backend platform services that power consumer applications and developer integrations. My work focuses on balancing product delivery with long-term platform investments to ensure systems remain scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

Areas of focus include:

• Distributed systems architecture
• SaaS platform development
• Microservices and API design
• Cloud infrastructure and scalable data systems
• Engineering leadership and team development
• Platform reliability and performance optimization

I enjoy building engineering organizations that ship impactful software while maintaining strong technical foundations.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Lead a team of engineers building distributed backend services and platform infrastructure supporting consumer applications and developer integrations. Responsible for delivering scalable microservices, APIs, and cloud-based systems powering live products while maintaining high availability and performance.
positions.insights: Skills: AI Pair Programming / AI-Assisted Programming · Technical Leadership · Engineering Strategy · Team Leadership · Agile Development · Distributed Systems · C# · Engineering Management · .NET · gRPC · Backend Development · REST APIs · CockroachDB · Go (Programming Language) · Redis · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · PostgreSQL · Microservices · Platform Engineering
